header.cleanBody:
When summoning this revealed card, ignore the Summon Condition.

[Ultimate Trigger: [LV3][LV4] (When Attacks)]
When Ultimate Trigger hits, heavy exhaust an opposing Spirit.

After Ultimate Trigger, if your Life is at three or less, also, proceed to Cross Ultimate Trigger.
[Cross Ultimate Trigger] When Cross Ultimate Trigger hits, if the opponent controls any heavily exhausted Spirits, send an opposing Life to their Reserve.
[xutb]
